title: KeyError when removing an event listener that had been added to two scoped sessions

labels.name: events
labels.description: SQLAlchemy event hooks, the event system

labels.name: great mcve
labels.description: An issue with a great mcve

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Describe the bug

Hey there 👋 

There seems to be a bug in `lib/sqlalchemy/event/registry.py::_removed_from_collection` or the way `owner_ref` and `listen_ref` get built that causes a `KeyError` exception to be raised when a same event listener gets added and then removed from two different scoped sessions.

With the debugger I've seen that in both the `event.remove` calls we end up with the same `listen_ref` and `owner_ref` variables in  `_removed_from_collection`. In the first pass we're able to successfully do `listener_to_key.pop(listen_ref)`, but in the second we get the error as that dictionary is empty.

I don't know if it's intended to have the same `listen_ref` and `owner_ref`, but if so we could fix this by doing:
```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/event/registry.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/event/registry.py
index 773620f8b..76ef1bd37 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/event/registry.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/event/registry.py
@@ -152,8 +152,7 @@ def _removed_from_collection(
     if not dispatch_reg:
         del _key_to_collection[key]
 
-    if owner_ref in _collection_to_key:
-        listener_to_key = _collection_to_key[owner_ref]
+    if listener_to_key := _collection_to_key[owner_ref]:
         listener_to_key.pop(listen_ref)
```

I can in case open a PR for it, I would need some guidance though on where to add the tests for it.

### Optional link from https://docs.sqlalchemy.org which documents the behavior that is expected

_No response_

### SQLAlchemy Version in Use

1.4.54, 2.0.36

### DBAPI (i.e. the database driver)

sqlite, psycopg2

### Database Vendor and Major Version

PostgreSQL 14.13

### Python Version

3.10

### Operating system

OSX

### To Reproduce

```python
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.orm import scoped_session, sessionmaker

engine = create_engine("sqlite+pysqlite:///:memory:")

session_factory = sessionmaker(engine)
session1 = scoped_session(session_factory=session_factory)
session2 = scoped_session(session_factory=session_factory)


def end_savepoint(session, transaction):
    pass


event.listen(session1, "after_transaction_end", end_savepoint)
event.listen(session2, "after_transaction_end", end_savepoint)

event.remove(session1, "after_transaction_end", end_savepoint)
event.remove(session2, "after_transaction_end", end_savepoint)
```


### Error

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Users/gius/sqlalchemy-test/tmp.py", line 19, in <module>
    event.remove(session2, "after_transaction_end", end_savepoint)
  File "/Users/gius/.pyenv/versions/3.10.4/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sqlalchemy/event/api.py", line 219, in remove
    _event_key(target, identifier, fn).remove()
  File "/Users/gius/.pyenv/versions/3.10.4/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sqlalchemy/event/registry.py", line 327, in remove
    collection.remove(self.with_wrapper(listener_fn))
  File "/Users/gius/.pyenv/versions/3.10.4/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sqlalchemy/event/attr.py", line 231, in remove
    registry._removed_from_collection(event_key, self)
  File "/Users/gius/.pyenv/versions/3.10.4/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sqlalchemy/event/registry.py", line 157, in _removed_from_collection
    listener_to_key.pop(listen_ref)
KeyError: <weakref at 0x1021dc220; to 'function' at 0x1021cd360 (end_savepoint)>
```
